author: Worker B (historical token-efficiency audit), Echelon research program

conventions.totalTokens: input + output + cache_read + cache_write, summed over the sessions named; cache buckets are never folded into input. Platform figures are get_session external_metadata.usage; transcript figures are self-measured (output is a streaming-start lower bound).
conventions.deltaPct: (treatment - baseline) / baseline * 100, computed by this audit from the raw files listed, only when comparable is true. Negative = treatment used fewer tokens.
conventions.cost: Platform-reported USD estimates are quoted as a secondary cross-check only; no cost is inferred from tokens and no saving is inferred from elapsed time.
